main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 2-bar return of Sunday cases with forecast > 0

statistic.name: t of the mean of per-Sunday cross-coin means

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 2-bar return on forecast

decided_by: the numbers meet neither the confirm nor the reject rule (t between -2 and 2, or sign and t disagree).
reading: Sunday bar = bar whose UTC start timestamp is a Sunday; the coin's mean 2-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 2, 4, ...) of all its windows pooled; cases without 2 later bars in the window are dropped; the t uses the unweighted cross-coin mean of excess returns per Sunday; the slope is an ordinary least-squares fit of excess return on forecast over all cases.
